section.p: Consider a procedure where a table provides reference information needed before the user performs the next step.

entry.codeblock: # Configuring Alarm Severity 1. Open the Alarm Configuration page. | Severity | Response Time | |-----------|-----------| | Critical | Immediate | | Warning | 15 Minutes | 2. Select the appropriate severity level. 3. Save the configuration.

<task id="configuring_alarm_severity"> <title>Configuring Alarm Severity</title> <taskbody> <steps> <step> <cmd>Open the Alarm Configuration page.</cmd> <info> <simpletable> <sthead> <stentry>Severity</stentry> <stentry>Response Time</stentry> </sthead> <strow> <stentry>Critical</stentry> <stentry>Immediate</stentry> </strow> <strow> <stentry>Warning</stentry> <stentry>15 Minutes</stentry> </strow> </simpletable> </info> </step> <step> <cmd>Select the appropriate severity level.</cmd> </step> <step> <cmd>Save the configuration.</cmd> </step> </steps> </taskbody> </task>

section.p: Result: The converter associates the table with the preceding step and places it within the corresponding <info> element. The table becomes supporting information for the step rather than interrupting the procedural flow.
